name: Double-barreled shotgun
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 43, Ultimate Combat pg. 140
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 43, Ultimate Combat pg. 140
Statistics
Cost 7,000 gp Weight 15 lbs.
Damage 1d6 (small), 1d8 (medium); Critical x2; Range 20 ft.; Type B and P; Special scatter
Misfire 1-2; Capacity 2
Category Two-Handed; Proficiency Exotic
Description
This twin-barreled shotgun’s barrels can be fired independently as separate attacks, or both can be fired at once as a standard action (the attack action). A double shot that fires bullets is inaccurate, and takes a –4 penalty on both attacks. A double shot that fires bullets targets only a single creature and increases the damage of each barrel to 2d6 points (Small) or 2d8 points (Medium) for a total of 4d6 or 4d8 points of damage. A double-barreled shotgun uses metal cartridges (loaded with either a bullet or pellets) as ammunition. This is an advanced firearm.
